name: CLI Context Generation
statement: A developer generates a knowledge summary suitable for system prompt injection, receiving either a formatted text block or structured JSON of relevant beliefs.
successCriteria: limen context --subject 'entity:project:*' returns text-formatted knowledge summary by default
limen context --format json returns JSON array of BeliefView objects
limen context --format text returns JSON with 'text' field containing markdown-formatted summary
limen context --minConfidence 0.8 filters by confidence threshold
limen context --limit 5 limits number of beliefs included
Empty results return 'No relevant beliefs found' text
All stdout is valid JSON, all errors go to stderr as JSON
failureCriteria: limen context --format 'bogus' crashes instead of returning JSON error
limen context --limit 'abc' crashes instead of returning JSON error
limen context --minConfidence 2 crashes instead of returning JSON error
Text format output is not valid JSON wrapper
Any command outputs non-JSON to stdout
preconditions: limen init completed (~/.limen/ exists with master key and config)
